description: Resource Type definition for AWS::StorageGateway::SMBFileShare. An SMB file share exposes an Amazon S3 bucket through a Storage Gateway file gateway, so clients read and write objects as files over SMB. The share's variant is fixed by its resource type rather than by a property: the service constructs the two variants with different APIs, and a property carrying the choice would belong to neither API's input.

NFSFileShareDefaults.description: Default values for the file and directory permissions of an NFS share.

FileMode.description: The Unix file mode in the form nnnn.

DirectoryMode.description: The Unix directory mode in the form nnnn.

GroupId.description: The default group ID for files in the file share.

OwnerId.description: The default owner ID for files in the file share.

CacheAttributes.description: Refresh cache information for the file share. Removing this property from a template leaves the share's current value: the service documents no value that resets it.

CacheStaleTimeoutInSeconds.description: How long the directory contents cached by the gateway are considered valid.

Tag.description: A key-value pair assigned to the file share.

GatewayARN.description: The ARN of the S3 File Gateway that hosts the share.

Role.description: The ARN of the IAM role the gateway assumes when it accesses the S3 location.

LocationARN.description: The ARN of the S3 bucket, or bucket prefix, the share exposes.

BucketRegion.description: The Region of the S3 bucket, required when the bucket is reached through a VPC endpoint.

VPCEndpointDNSName.description: The DNS name of the S3 VPC endpoint the gateway uses to reach the bucket.

EncryptionType.description: The server-side encryption the gateway applies to objects it writes.

KMSEncrypted.description: Deprecated by the service in favour of EncryptionType; true selects KMS encryption. Retained because it remains readable and settable.

KMSKey.description: The KMS key used for encryption, when EncryptionType selects KMS. Removing this property from a template leaves the share's current value: the service documents no value that resets it.

DefaultStorageClass.description: The S3 storage class for new objects. The service accepts S3_STANDARD, S3_INTELLIGENT_TIERING, S3_STANDARD_IA and S3_ONEZONE_IA; it is a length-bounded string in the API model rather than an enumeration.

ObjectACL.description: The canned S3 ACL applied to objects the gateway writes.

ReadOnly.description: Whether clients may write to the share.

GuessMIMETypeEnabled.description: Whether the gateway infers the MIME type of uploaded objects from their extension.

RequesterPays.description: Whether the bucket is a Requester Pays bucket.

FileShareName.description: The name of the file share, which defaults to the bucket name when omitted. Removing this property from a template leaves the share's current value: the service documents no value that resets it.

NotificationPolicy.description: The upload-notification settling period, as a JSON document.

AuditDestinationARN.description: The ARN of the CloudWatch log group that receives the share's audit logs. Removing this property from a template detaches audit logging: the update sends the empty string, which the service treats as the reset.

Tags.description: Tags assigned to the file share.

SMBACLEnabled.description: Whether the SMB share uses Windows ACLs rather than POSIX permissions.

AccessBasedEnumeration.description: Whether clients see only the files and folders they may access.

AdminUserList.description: Users and groups granted administrative privileges on the SMB share.

ValidUserList.description: Users and groups permitted to access the SMB share.

InvalidUserList.description: Users and groups denied access to the SMB share.

Authentication.description: The authentication the SMB share uses. The service accepts ActiveDirectory and GuestAccess; it is a length-bounded string in the API model rather than an enumeration.

CaseSensitivity.description: Whether the SMB share is case sensitive or defers to the client.

OplocksEnabled.description: Whether the SMB share grants opportunistic locks. Removing this property from a template leaves the live value unchanged rather than restoring the created default, because that default depends on the gateway's software version -- opportunistic locking is enabled by default only on appliances at 1.19.0.0 or above -- and the version is not part of this resource. Set the value explicitly rather than relying on removal.

FileShareARN.description: The ARN of the file share.

FileShareId.description: The ID of the file share.

FileShareStatus.description: The status of the file share. The service reports CREATING, UPDATING, AVAILABLE, DELETING and FORCE_DELETING; it is a length-bounded string in the API model rather than an enumeration.

Path.description: The export path the share is mounted or mapped at.
